step_blurb: Make the folders, check the tools and databases, offer to install what is missing.
label: Check tools and databases
description: Creates the folders and checks what is installed. Always runs; fast.

step_blurb: Make the folders, check the tools and databases, offer to install what is missing.
label: Docker (container engine)
description: Optional. Runs PlasBench in a container (scripts/docker_run.sh) and is the container engine tools such as mobilome-map and plsmd need. Its state is shown here; Install Docker (plasbench install-tools docker) asks you first, uses winget or Homebrew where it can and otherwise shows the exact steps. Never sudo, and the Docker Desktop licence is accepted by you.

step_blurb: Fetch each isolate's reference assembly and Illumina reads.
label: Download reads and references
description: Fetches the reference assembly and the Illumina reads for each isolate. Skipped for your own local files.
basis: Disk: README 'What the machine needs' (about 630 MB per isolate, documented, not re-measured here). Time depends on the link and is not measured per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Build the truth table
description: Labels each reference sequence plasmid or chromosome from the NCBI sequence report.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Annotate the reference
description: Calls the installed annotation tools (replicon typing, AMR genes, insertion sequences) on the reference. A diagnostic; never changes F1.
basis: Not measured. It runs external callers once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: MOB-typer (replicon typing)
description: One of the reference annotation tools: replicon and relaxase types. Install it from here; switch it off to skip it. A caller that is off or missing is recorded as not evaluated.
basis: Not measured. One external caller, run once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: abricate (AMR and replicon genes)
description: One of the reference annotation tools: AMR genes and replicons by BLAST against its own databases. Install it from here; switch it off to skip it.
basis: Not measured. One external caller, run once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: AMRFinderPlus (AMR genes)
description: One of the reference annotation tools: AMR genes. It needs its database, fetched once (about 100 MB) when you install it here. Switch it off to skip it.
basis: Not measured. One external caller, run once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: ISEScan (insertion sequences)
description: One of the reference annotation tools, and the slowest (minutes per genome). Install it from here; switch it off to skip it and save the time.
basis: Not measured. One external caller, run once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: barrnap (rRNA genes)
description: One of the reference annotation tools: rRNA genes, used as chromosomal evidence. Install it from here; switch it off to skip it.
basis: Not measured. One external caller, run once per isolate.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Evidence-based truth labels
description: Marks replicons whose plasmid or chromosome label conflicts with the evidence as ambiguous and leaves them out of scoring.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Detect dimers in the truth
description: Flags reference plasmids that look like a doubled copy.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Repeat content of the truth
description: Measures the k-mer repeat content of the truth plasmids.

step_blurb: Work out which reference sequences are plasmid and which are chromosome.
label: Read-depth anomalies in the truth
description: Finds windows of unusual read depth on the truth.

step_blurb: Check the reads, trim them and assemble the contigs the tools work on.
label: Short-read QC gate
description: Measures the reads before assembly and flags (report) or excludes (enforce) poor ones. Off skips it. The window switches report and off; enforce is in Settings.

step_blurb: Check the reads, trim them and assemble the contigs the tools work on.
label: Trim and assemble
description: Trims the reads with fastp and assembles them with SPAdes (or Unicycler). The tools run on this assembly.
basis: Median of 10 real isolates, 356 s (mean 711 s, range 292-1908 s): results_real_cohort1/assembly_status.tsv. Memory not recorded; the README notes SPAdes memory grows with read depth (a 250x isolate needed 7.8 GB for k-mer counting).

step_blurb: Check the reads, trim them and assemble the contigs the tools work on.
label: Assembly selection
description: Measures each candidate assembly and records the policy's choice (report) or runs the tools on it (enforce). Off skips it.

step_blurb: Check the reads, trim them and assemble the contigs the tools work on.
label: Isolate difficulty features
description: Truth-derived difficulty descriptors (an alignment and two external-tool calls per isolate) used to explain results.
basis: Not measured. config.sh notes an alignment and two external-tool calls per isolate.

step_blurb: Run each enabled plasmid tool on every assembly. Your own tools run here too.
label: MOB-recon
description: Groups contigs into plasmid bins (binning reconstruction).
basis: Median 54 s and largest peak memory 2.95 GB over 10 real isolates: results_real_cohort1/tool_status.tsv (10 real isolates, PlasBench 0.2.3). Database size: README (documented).

step_blurb: Run each enabled plasmid tool on every assembly. Your own tools run here too.
label: Platon
description: Labels each contig plasmid or chromosome (classification).
basis: Median 59 s and largest peak memory 4.38 GB over 10 real isolates: results_real_cohort1/tool_status.tsv (10 real isolates, PlasBench 0.2.3). Database size: README (documented).

step_blurb: Run each enabled plasmid tool on every assembly. Your own tools run here too.
label: plasmidSPAdes
description: Re-assembles plasmid-enriched contigs (sequence reassembly).
basis: Median 398 s (mean 763 s, longest 2021 s) and largest peak memory 3.77 GB over 10 real isolates: results_real_cohort1/tool_status.tsv (10 real isolates, PlasBench 0.2.3). It reads the original reads, so the time grows with depth.

step_blurb: Run each enabled plasmid tool on every assembly. Your own tools run here too.
label: gplas2 (MOB-seeded)
description: Graph binning seeded from MOB-recon's membership; always waits for MOB-recon.

description: Random-forest classifier of contigs.
needs_database: CheckM reference data (about 1.4 GB, set up once)

description: Runs the statistics simulation and shows it in the report (smoke mode: seconds; full mode: minutes).

step_blurb: Combine the isolates into the leaderboard, the statistics and the report.
label: Leaderboard and report
description: Builds the leaderboard, the statistics and the HTML report. Always runs.
basis: Not measured per isolate. docs/PERFORMANCE_AUDIT.md measured stage 6 at 80 s for 20 isolates by 8 tools on synthetic data before its speed-ups (synthetic, an earlier code version).
